params.query: offline vs online revenue sales channel

params.sql: select table_name from `sahil-devx.dev_dna_silver.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES` where lower(table_name) like '%channel%'

measures.expr: sum(case when sales.channel_code in ('OFFLINE','CAFE') then sales.revenue_inr else 0 end)
measures.name: offline_rev

measures.expr: sum(case when sales.channel_code not in ('OFFLINE','CAFE') then sales.revenue_inr else 0 end)
measures.name: online_rev
